test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: India’s dependency on food aid reduced after the Green Revolution. Which US program had earlier provided wheat aid to India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**PL-480**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PL-480** stands for the **Public Law 480**, also referred to as the **Food for Peace Program**.
 
• This program was initiated by the **United States in 1954** to provide food aid to countries facing food shortages.
 
• Under this program, India received **substantial amounts of wheat and other grains** during the 1950s and 1960s to address its chronic food insecurity.
 
• The dependency on PL-480 reduced significantly after the **Green Revolution in India**, which began in the late 1960s and led to an increase in agricultural production.
 
• This program was a form of **economic assistance** and was instrumental in building **US-India relations** during the initial years of India's independence.
 
• PL-480 not only supported India during its food crises but also laid the groundwork for the modernization of India's **agricultural sector**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **KL-580**__

 __
 
• **KL-580** appears to be an arbitrary term with no specific historical or factual relevance to India's food aid or agricultural history.
 
 
 
• **Marshall Plan**__
 __
 
• The **Marshall Plan** was a post-World War II initiative by the **United States** to provide economic assistance for the reconstruction of **Europe**.
 
• This plan was not related to food aid in India but focused on rebuilding war-torn European economies during the late 1940s and early 1950s.
 
 
 
• **Green Aid**__
 
 
• **Green Aid** does not correspond to any specific program or initiative associated with India's food aid or agricultural development.
 
• The term might be confused with the **Green Revolution**, which was a domestic Indian initiative to increase agricultural productivity.
